header: A chat message written in WhatsApp:
text: Arre yaar, aaj shaam free hai kya? Socha tha sab milke nayi movie dekhne chalte hain. Show 7 baje ka hai, tickets main book kar dungi. Uske baad paas wale dhabe pe dinner kar lenge. Bas jaldi bata de ki tu aa raha hai ya nahi, taaki main sabki seats saath mein le sakun.

text: Mummy, main traffic mein phas gaya hoon, around 20 minute late ho jaunga. Aap log khana shuru kar do, mera wait mat karna. Raste mein mithai ki dukaan padti hai, toh main dadi ke liye rasgulle le aaunga. Kisi ko aur kuch chahiye toh abhi bata do, baad mein phone mat karna please.

header: A chat message written in WhatsApp:
text: Bahut bahut congratulations! Sun ke itni khushi hui ki finally tujhe new job mil gayi. Pichle kuch months se tu kitni mehnat kar raha tha, mujhe pata hai. Next week jab tu city aayega, tab proper party karenge. Aur haan, new office mein first day kaisa raha, zaroor batana.

text: Thanks yaar, aaj subah support queue sambhalne ke liye. Bahut help ho gayi. Ab main wapas aa gaya hoon, toh aage ka kaam main dekh lunga. Agar koi ticket beech mein reh gaya ho, toh usme ek chhota sa note likh dena, main wahi se continue kar lunga.

header: A chat message written in WhatsApp:
text: Guys, Goa trip ka final plan bana lete hain. Flights abhi sasti hain, toh is weekend tak book kar leni chahiye. Main soch raha tha ki hum 15 se 19 tak chalein, Friday ko leave le lenge. text: Arre tension mat le, sab theek ho jayega. Interview mein ek do sawaal galat ho jaate hain, isse koi farak nahi padta. Tune baaki sab kitna achha handle kiya, wo dekh. Aaj raat aaram se so ja, kal subah call karte hain aur next steps discuss karenge. Aur haan, khana time pe kha lena.

Is week ke kaam

Electricity bill Friday se pehle bharna hai. Mummy ki medicines khatam hone wali hain, chemist se new prescription ke saath laani hain. Bachon ki school fees isi month deni hai. Car ki servicing bhi due hai, Saturday ka slot book karna hai. Agar Sunday ko weather achha raha toh balcony ki safai karenge.

header: A product review written in a browser:
text: Main ye pressure cooker pichle teen mahine se daily use kar rahi hoon. Dal aur chawal bahut jaldi ban jaate hain aur lid aaram se band ho jaata hai. Seeti thodi loud hai, but koi problem nahi hoti. Handle garam nahi hota, ye mujhe sabse achha laga. Price ke hisaab se ye value for money product hai, main zaroor recommend karungi.
